topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: They say the pen is mightier than the sword, but what good is might when someone takes your words and plants them where they don’t belong? I sweated over that essay, pouring more than just ink into those pages. It’s one thing to share with a University, but to pin it up for the world to see, like a fine piece of linen on market day? No warning, no word. Now all and sundry can claim they penned the thoughts I wrestled from my very bones. A man’s thoughts are his own, or so I thought. Some saintly protection I needed against such thievery! It’s a hard thing to see your words made common, when you aimed for something more.
